name: vague-bench
description: Evaluates model behavior on vague or underspecified queries, measuring whether models ask clarifying questions, avoid overconfident hallucinations, and provide appropriately scoped answers. It focuses on robustness to ambiguous user intents and response specificity.
reputation: An emerging, small-scale Hugging Face benchmark for research into ambiguity handling and clarification by LLMs; limited adoption so far.
